claim: Every casual project add/delete shows developer/engine text: runRepoOp(registryLockKey, ...) makes the op-result Subject the lock key "_registry", and since casual adds always grant, the output line is "added <name> (<path>) + additionalDirectories grant" — jargon spec-1/2 say the casual user never reads.
fix: For the casual audience give add/delete a translated human Subject (the repo label) and a translated result line (e.g. t "Project added"), keeping the lock key and the additionalDirectories wording for the developer audience only; add the strings to germanCatalog.

claim: install.ps1 forwards the profile as two argv words (-presentation-profile $PresentationProfile); with the default empty value Windows PowerShell 5.1 drops the empty argument, configserver.exe gets a trailing flag with no value, flag.Parse exits 2 and every default from-source Windows install fails.
fix: Forward the profile as one token, "-presentation-profile=$PresentationProfile", so an empty value survives Windows PowerShell 5.1's empty-argument dropping.

claim: ruleDelta reads the working side of changed declaration files from disk while acdsl check loads rules only from FileUniverse; `git rm --cached acdsl/rules.acdsl` plus a .git/info/exclude entry disables every central rule while CheckPolicy reports zero removed rules in a gated/strict repo.
fix: In ruleDelta, take the working side only for paths in FileUniverse(ctx, root) — a changed path absent from the universe counts as deleted so its base rules land in delta.removed; keep the refuter's TestRefuteMaj9 scenario as a policy_test.go case.

claim: GitChangedFiles tokenizes git diff --name-only / ls-files --others output with strings.Fields and without -z, so a declaration file whose path has a space or non-ASCII byte never reaches ruleDelta under its real name and contributes no rules on either side; gated/strict branches can change protected rules in such a file unreported.
fix: Use `git diff --name-only -z <base>` and `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z`, split on NUL instead of strings.Fields, so paths reach ruleDelta verbatim.

claim: policyBase recognizes the base branch only by stripping a literal "origin/" prefix, so with base_ref "upstream/main" or "refs/heads/main" a human on the base branch itself is treated as a boundary and uncommitted surface changes on main are flagged, contradicting correctness-71.
fix: Treat HEAD == rev-parse(<candidate>) as the vacuous case alongside the branch-name match, or derive baseName from git rev-parse --symbolic-full-name <candidate> with refs/heads/ or refs/remotes/<remote>/ stripped.

claim: On a casual German install the Projekte add form includes _repo_path.html whose "Choose folder…", "chosen:" and "picker failed" literals bypass t and have no germanCatalog entry.
fix: Wrap the three _repo_path.html literals in t and add German entries for them to germanCatalog.

claim: Duty 5 assumes the invoking wrapper already appended registry paths to permissions.additionalDirectories and bootstrap mode claims duties 3-7 are identical, but cmd/bootstrap/run.sh only reads additionalDirectories; bootstrap never reconciles, against correctness-60.
fix: Append the missing registry paths to additionalDirectories in cmd/bootstrap/run.sh before the orchestrate stage with the same append-only jq as smine-nightly run.sh L298-305 (coordinate with known BLK-8-r2 and BLK-22-r1 on the same settings files), or make L61 name only the nightly wrapper and have bootstrap mode do the append itself.

claim: Duty 4 re-syncs a context pack only for targets carrying docs/context.json, while sync_context.sh writes and records packs under <target>/<context-dir>/; a pack deployed with --context-dir context is never re-synced.
fix: Detect a deployed pack by any <target>/<dir>/context.json that carries a deploy section (deploy.contextDir), and re-run sync_context.sh with --context-dir <recorded dir> plus the other recorded flags.

claim: The self-mining exclusion drops sessions inside 'the run's repo root', but nightly mining runs from a routine worktree under ~/.cache, so the operator's sessions in the main checkout and its .claude/worktrees/ escape the exclusion with dev mode off.
fix: Define the exclusion root as the main checkout (first entry of git worktree list, or the parent of git rev-parse --git-common-dir), not the cwd toplevel, and state that this holds when the run executes in a routine worktree.

claim: The step-4 casual lockout checks only skills-kind proposals; context-kind routes (acdsl-context declaration amendments, eviction from a skill's context:) also edit shipped skill files, which smine-orchestrate L41 treats as a hard breach on casual installs — the proposal is archived as implemented and the change reverted or the night rejected.
fix: Widen the casual lockout to any proposal whose implementation edits files of a skill lacking origin: user (disposition casual-locked), and have smine-context and smine-memory drop declaration and eviction candidates against such skills on casual installs.

claim: The Drift stage's sessions/<scope>/analyzed-*.txt glob now also matches smine-batch's per-folder analyzed-sessions.txt, which holds skipped ids the dimension ledgers omit, so every skipped session is reported as drift on every run.
fix: Restrict the Drift prompt to the five dimension ledgers by name (analyzed-{memory,skill,routines,rules,permissions}.txt) and exclude analyzed-sessions.txt explicitly.

claim: TestWelcomeBootstrapConcurrent passes without the running guard: its server has no TokenDir, so the token guard also answers 409 and the test asserts only the status.
fix: Give TestWelcomeBootstrapConcurrent a TokenDir holding one labeled token so only the running guard can answer 409, and assert the body contains "already in progress".

claim: The verdict cache made test_steady_state_runs_no_probes vacuous: the traced runs at 557/560 hit the cache written by the run at 556, so evaluate_branch never runs.
fix: Run the traced invocations at lines 557 and 560 with WORKTREE_STATUS_NO_CACHE=1 (or remove .git/agent-status-cache first) so the no-probe assertion exercises evaluate_branch.

claim: New LoadFragment returns "reading %s: %w" and "parsing %s: %w" without the LoadFragment: prefix.
fix: Prefix LoadFragment's two errors as "LoadFragment: Failed to read %s: %w" and "LoadFragment: Failed to parse %s: %w".

claim: The new nested-run scan nests its success path under `if err == nil {`, three control levels deep.
fix: Extract the nested-run scan into loadNestedEvalDirs(dir, skill) that returns early on the ReadDir error, and append its results in LoadForSkill.

claim: Free function validateScopeName sits inside Store's method block.
fix: Move validateScopeName below the last Store method into the unexported free-function group.

claim: TestFingerprint's run git closure duplicates the one inside gitRepoWithAgentWorktrees.
fix: Extract one runGit(t, repo, args...) helper (carrying the -c user.* flags) and use it in both gitRepoWithAgentWorktrees and TestFingerprint.

claim: TestLoadPolicy cases unknown-mode and malformed-json omit the declared _shouldPass meta field.
fix: Set `_shouldPass: false` explicitly in the unknown-mode (L117) and malformed-json (L124) case literals; input fields stay as they are.

claim: The SyncAll doc comment was not reflowed: L17 reads only '// Called once at'.
fix: Reflow the SyncAll doc comment so 'Called once at server startup: ...' continues the paragraph instead of a stray short line at L17.

claim: The Windows SyncAll doc comment states unregistered -> register+enable unconditionally while the body skips default-disabled routines.
fix: Amend the Windows SyncAll comment: unregistered -> register+enable unless the routine carries a default-disabled marker, matching the darwin twin.

claim: New early-return guard blocks at L43-45 and L92-94 are followed by code with no blank line.
fix: Insert a blank line after the guard blocks ending at L45 (Repo.Validate Name guard) and L94 (refreshIfChanged), and after the same misses the verifier found in new code at L142 and L190.

claim: The package doc names only the flat evals layouts while LoadForSkill reads and ManifestStub emits the nested evals/<skill>/<date>-<hash>/ layout.
fix: Extend the package doc to name the nested evals/<skill>/<date>-<hash>/ run-directory layout next to the flat ones.

claim: New handleSessionsArchiveTab is placed after handleSessionsBatch, breaking alphabetical handler order.
fix: Move handleSessionsArchiveTab above handleSessionsBatch so the handler methods stay alphabetical.

claim: The claude-revert predicate is spelled twice in one closure (L50 and its negation at L70).
fix: Name the predicate once (isClaudeRevert := revert && target != catalog.TargetCodex), pass it to copyFileAtomic and use if !isClaudeRevert at line 70.

claim: The newTestServer construction block is repeated 9 times with no helper.
fix: Add a newProfileServer(t) helper (temp presentation/style paths + stub sync script) and call it from each case block.

claim: The audience-gated snippet <summary> expression is copied verbatim from _proposal_card.html:81.
fix: Extract the audience-gated snippet <summary> expression into one {{define "_snippet_summary.html"}} partial and use it from both _session_list.html:35 and _proposal_card.html:81.

claim: class="wt-kinds" has no stylesheet rule or script reference — a dead class.
fix: Drop class="wt-kinds" from the Worktrees cell.

claim: cmd.Start of bash running cmd/bootstrap/run.sh is reported as "Failed to start claude".
fix: Reword to "handleWelcomeBootstrap: Failed to start the bootstrap wrapper: %w".

claim: Five TestLoadPresentationProfile literals omit the asserted meta field _expectedDevMode while another literal sets the same zero value.
fix: Add `_expectedDevMode: false,` to the five literals that omit it (missing-file-defaults, de-casual-parsed, missing-front-matter-defaults, unknown-audience-kept-verbatim, empty-language-defaults-en).

claim: The <h1> re-derives the Repos/Projects title that handleReposIndex already sets as .Title.
fix:
Replace the re-derived heading with `

{{.Title}}

` so the handler's Title is the single source.

claim: The header's removal criterion omits squash containment, which this diff made a removal ground.
fix: Extend the header's safe-to-lose bullet (lines 14-17) with the squash-containment layer (a candidate squash-contains the whole branch via verdict.sh squash_contained), matching the status script's header.

claim: The new 'Known documentation gap' section carries an unticketed 'reconcile before shipping' action item while line 158 still cites the absent RULE-GOLANG-POINTER-003.
fix: Re-home the forbid-addr-lit citation at lines 151 and 158 onto an existing rule id in this change, or replace 'reconcile before shipping' with a ticket/plan reference.

claim: hash_explained_anywhere sits 156 lines above the explained_pairs global it iterates and its siblings.
fix: Move hash_explained_anywhere directly below is_explained (after line 278), next to the explained_pairs declaration it reads.

claim: squash_contained "$from" runs a git merge-tree before the candidate check, dead work for a local FROM.
fix: Evaluate squash_contained only for a non-candidate FROM: `if [ "$(candidate_index "$from")" -lt 0 ] && { [ "$all_transferred" -eq 1 ] || squash_contained "$from" "$branch"; }; then eval_in="$from*..."; fi`.

claim: peekIdentity takes no ctx and uses client.Get although its caller startPeek holds the signal ctx.
fix: Change to peekIdentity(ctx context.Context, addr string), build the request with http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, url, nil) plus client.Do, and pass ctx from startPeek.

claim: Two back-to-back args = append(args, ...) calls where one variadic append carries both flag pairs.
fix: Merge the two appends into one multiline call: args = append(args, "--control-port", strconv.Itoa(controlPort), "--back-link", backLink).

claim: phase('Gate') is called inside a barrier-less pipeline() stage, flipping the global phase once per template while other Render agents still run.
fix: Delete the in-stage phase('Gate') call (opts.phase already labels the agent).

claim: The six-field failed-gate result literal is spelled out twice (L64-71 and L88-95).
fix: Extract a failedGate(template, reason) helper returning the six-field failed result and use it at L64 and L88.

claim: The purpose paragraph and description still list the v1.0 'exactly four questions' beside the v1.1 State / Why / Validation & testing / DoD template.
fix: Reword the purpose paragraph (L13) and description (L3) to the v1.1 shape: State, Why this solution, Validation & testing, Definition of Done.

claim: The new skill reuses smine-context's retired name smine-style, and smine-context L29 still cites 'the smine-style rename'.
fix: Reword smine-context SKILL.md L29 to name the smine-rules/smine-style -> smine-context renames explicitly, or rename the new skill (author's call: the name is already wired into routines and the Profile page).

claim: Step 4 restates the origin: user stamp rule that skillroutine-create L36 now owns.
fix: Drop the origin: user restatement from smine-apply step 4 and defer to skillroutine-create's skill-route format (L36).

claim: A one-repo sync_public.sh --exclude assertion landed unconditionally in the generic fimplement skill; no sync_public.sh exists in this repo.
fix: Move the sync_public.sh exclude check into a context entry reached only by the repo that owns sync_public.sh, or make the bullet conditional on that script existing.

claim: The bullet heading says 'merge base ref' (git's fork-point term) for the merged ref.
fix: Rename the bullet heading to 'Assert the merged ref is the exact ref the user named.'

claim: The Setup ToolSearch-load list omits mcp__Peek_MCP__session_get, which allowed-tools grants and Subagent mining calls.
fix: Add mcp__Peek_MCP__session_get (with the subagent: <id> parameter note) to the L33 Setup data-source list.

claim: The single ACDSL-JSON-003 fail fixture carries both the mode and the unknown-key defect, so additionalProperties:false is pinned by nothing.
fix: Reduce fail/policy.json to the mode defect, and pin additionalProperties with a Go test validating an unknown-key-only document (valid mode) against acdsl/policy.schema.json, since the fail set is judged as a whole.

claim: runCheck's merge of policy diagnostics into output and exit code has no test.
fix: Add a test_acdsl.sh scenario: temp git repo with a committed gated policy, work branch adding an ACDSL-PLAN-* rule, assert acdsl check exits 1 and prints an [ACDSL-POLICY] line.

claim: ruleDelta's deleted-declaration-file path is never exercised by a test.
fix: Add a policy_test.go case that removes acdsl/rules.acdsl on the work branch and asserts CheckPolicy reports rule ACDSL-PLAN-100 removed outside the editable scopes.

claim: Every invalid-name scope assertion passes with validateScopeName removed, and UnarchiveScope has no invalid-name case.
fix: Create <root>/livescope, assert DeleteScope("../livescope") and UnarchiveScope("../livescope") error and livescope still exists; add UnarchiveScope("archived") and UnarchiveScope("") error cases.

claim: The request-time reloadSessions in handleOverview has no test; New() already reloads.
fix: Add a TestOverview subtest that writes a batch JSON after newTestServer and asserts the Sessions analyzed tile counts it on the next GET /.

claim: The fingerprintErr == nil term in the status cache decision has no test.
fix: Add a status-fragment case whose registry entry is a non-git temp dir with the counting stub: two plain loads must run the script twice and never render ' · cached'.

claim: The permissions kind's default dimension harness-friction is never asserted.
fix: Add one resolvable evidence session to the permissions fixture and assert its link carries dimension=harness-friction.

claim: The gate's string-content first-user-message branch is never exercised; every test transcript uses array content.
fix: Add a string-content REQUIRE-SKILL transcript ({type:"user", message:{content:$t}}) to test_skill_invoke_gate.sh and assert pre-invocation deny and post-invocation silence.

claim: No test drives sync_hooks.sh, so the EOF-answers-n prune guard is unpinned.
fix: Add cmd/tests/test_sync_hooks.sh (picked up by the Makefile's cmd/tests/test_*.sh loop): stale installed hook, run with </dev/null, assert exit 0 and 'kept:'; with 'y' on stdin assert pruned.

claim: Every test_bootstrap_wrapper.sh case is a dry run, so the token gate, results logging, status propagation and dirty-tree postcondition never execute.
fix: Add non-dry-run cases with a stub claude on PATH: dirty-tree stub asserts exit 70 and a results line, failing stub on clean tree asserts its exit code, missing token file asserts exit 78.
